inspiration.source_location: AttachLabelToIssueOnCreate in server/pkg/db/queries/issue_label.sql: UPDATE ... WHERE ... AND NOT EXISTS (junction row) AND EXISTS (workspace-scoped label of the matching resource type) followed by the idempotent junction INSERT ... WHERE EXISTS ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
inspiration.observed_pattern: An application attach operation keeps an activity timestamp honest with a guarded UPDATE: last_activity moves to GREATEST(COALESCE(nullable, fallback), now()) only when the junction row does not already exist and the target label is valid in the same workspace; the companion junction INSERT is idempotent so rerunning the attach adds no row.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an original knowledge-base scenario (kb_docs/kb_topics/kb_doc_topics). now() becomes the fixed literal '2026-09-15 12:00:00'; $1/::uuid parameters become concrete integer literals; the PostgreSQL data-modifying CTE plus ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING is translated to a WHERE NOT EXISTS guard on INSERT ... SELECT, which MariaDB 10.11.7 executes with the same observable final state; GREATEST and COALESCE keep their standard SQL forms.

fixture_notes: Docs 7 and 9 take the NULL last_touched_at coalesce path (doc 9's fallback is ahead of the literal, doc 7's is behind); doc 10 has a stale non-NULL value; docs 8, 11, 12 already hold the junction row so the anti-join guard skips them; doc 13 is in another workspace and must be excluded by both the UPDATE workspace guard and the attach join.
determinism_notes: All timestamps are literals; reads are ordered by primary key or by (doc_id, topic_id); the idempotent attach repeats the identical statement so its second observation is a stable zero-row insert.
setup: CREATE TABLE kb_docs (id INT PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id INT, last_touched_at DATETIME NULL, modified_at DATETIME NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE kb_topics (id INT PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id INT, name VARCHAR(32), kind VARCHAR(8))
CREATE TABLE kb_doc_topics (doc_id INT, topic_id INT, PRIMARY KEY (doc_id, topic_id))

steps.sql: UPDATE kb_docs SET last_touched_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_touched_at, modified_at), '2026-09-15 12:00:00') WHERE workspace_id = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_doc_topics dt WHERE dt.doc_id = kb_docs.id AND dt.topic_id = 11) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_topics t WHERE t.id = 11 AND t.workspace_id = kb_docs.workspace_id AND t.kind = 'doc')

INSERT INTO kb_doc_topics (doc_id, topic_id) SELECT d.id, t.id FROM kb_docs d JOIN kb_topics t ON t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id WHERE d.id IN (7, 8, 10, 13) AND t.id = 11 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_doc_topics x WHERE x.doc_id = d.id AND x.topic_id = t.id)

INSERT INTO kb_doc_topics (doc_id, topic_id) SELECT d.id, t.id FROM kb_docs d JOIN kb_topics t ON t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id WHERE d.id IN (7, 8, 10, 13) AND t.id = 11 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_doc_topics x WHERE x.doc_id = d.id AND x.topic_id = t.id)
DELETE FROM kb_doc_topics WHERE doc_id = 7 AND topic_id = 11 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_docs d WHERE d.id = kb_doc_topics.doc_id AND d.workspace_id = 1)

checks.sql: SELECT id, workspace_id, last_touched_at, modified_at FROM kb_docs ORDER BY id
